messages.text:
Our starter kit, free plans first:

1) An AI chat assistant for writing and thinking: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. All three have a free plan, so try the same prompt in two and keep the one you like.
2) Canva for posts, flyers and simple graphics (free plan).
3) A booking link so clients schedule themselves: Calendly has a free plan.

That's enough to run every prompt we post. Plans and limits change, so check each pricing page before you pay for anything.
